title: Library occupancy and forecasting
summary: Which desks are in use, and how busy will it get?
description:
My team and I worked with the university library on a problem: a lack of data about how its study places were used. Combining presence detectors and smart plugs, we determined whether a monitor place was in use and showed it on a display with other information.

We also built a custom forecasting model predicting how many people would be in the library at a given time.
